question: Who was the first Indian wrestler to win a world championship medal?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Udey Chand.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Udey Chand was the first Indian wrestler to win a world championship medal.
 
• He bagged a bronze medal in the men's freestyle 67kg category at the 1961 world championships held in Yokohama, Japan.
 
• His journey to the bronze medal was marked by skill, determination, and a strong representation of Indian wrestling on the global stage.
 
• His achievement not only brought pride to India but also paved the way for future generations of Indian wrestlers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• KD Jadhav:
 
 
• KD Jadhav is renowned for his bronze medal win in the 62 kg freestyle wrestling category at the 1952 Helsinki Olympics.
 
• This achievement brought India its first individual Olympic medal in wrestling.
 
• He was a multiple-time national champion in India, showcasing his dominance in the sport.
 
 
 
• Dara Singh:
 
 
• Dara Singh was a prominent figure in both the world of wrestling and Bollywood.
 
• He won numerous wrestling titles and starred in numerous popular films.
 
• His popularity helped to popularize wrestling in India, making it a widely recognized sport.
 
 
 
• Malwa Singh:
 
 
• Malwa Singh was a national champion in wrestling, demonstrating his skill and athleticism.
 
• He later transitioned to coaching and mentoring young wrestlers, contributing to the development of the sport in India.​
